A field guide to an inhabited world · volume XXV · the golem family

Constructs

Girls shaped by hand. The clay golem of Jewish folklore, here a village guardian who leads the iron golems.

Favourite food: Clay (she patches herself)

The central similarity

Made, not born.

A construct is shaped, not born: she has no young, and when she falls she breaks apart into clay.

  • ToughestMore health than an iron golem.
  • GuardianShe fights monsters near villagers.
  • KinIron golems follow her.
  • BreaksShe breaks into pieces when she falls.

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all MonsterGirls families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a construct builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /monstergirls bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Species profiles

VillagesSteadfast · silent

Golem (about 2.4 blocks)

TemperamentSteadfast, quiet

Ecology & behaviourThe golem of Jewish folklore: a figure shaped from clay and brought to life by a word on her brow.

Signature: Village guardian120 health, more than an iron golem. She fights monsters near villagers, and iron golems follow her. When she falls she breaks into pieces.

Player interactionClay. Defend the village with her.

TemperamentSilent by day, watchful by night

Signature: Stone by dayBy day she turns to stone: nothing hurts her. At night she wakes, flies, and fights monsters near her friend.

Talosling (about 1.5 blocks)

TemperamentLoyal, clockwork

Ecology & behaviourA Harmontide bronze automaton hound, a little Talos, that runs on a wound spring.

Signature: ClockworkRedstone dust winds her spring (five minutes a dust, up to twenty): while wound she guards her friend; run down, she sits still until wound again.

Player interactionRedstone winds her up.

Tin Jack (about 1.8 blocks)

TemperamentWatchful, a little spooky

Ecology & behaviourA Harmontide scarecrow of riveted blue tin in a tattered cloak and a pointed hat, a carved grin for a face and a lantern at her hip. Crows perch on her arm; nothing else dares.

Signature: ScarecrowBefriended, phantoms that come near her friend lose heart: weakened, they wheel away.

Automaton (about 1.7 blocks)

TemperamentDutiful, curious

Ecology & behaviourA Harmontide clockwork girl in pale-blue armour plates: a round helmet with a disc over each ear, rivets down every plate and a wind-up key she never lets anyone turn but a friend. Nobody remembers who built the first of them.

Signature: LamplighterBefriended, she sets torches (her friend's own) on the dark ground near her friend.

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Tin Jack: her lantern glows; befriended, phantoms near her friend lose heart, weakened, and wheel away
  • Golem: 120 health (more than an iron golem), heavy blows
  • Fights monsters near villagers (never creepers), and near her devoted friend
  • Iron golems are her kin
  • Made, not born: no bed, no young; clay heals her
  • Breaks into pieces when she falls
  • Automaton: befriended, she sets her friend's torches on the dark ground near them
  • Tin squirrel: breaks a worn iron or gold tool or armour piece down into nuggets (more the less worn it is); hoards the nuggets she finds
  • Talosling: redstone dust winds her (5 minutes each, 20 at most); wound up, she guards her friend; run down, she sits still until wound again
  • Gargoyle: stone by day (nothing hurts her), awake at night: she flies and fights monsters near her friend

Not yet

  • A copper golem

Design decisions log

Decided (2026-10-19)

  • The clay golem first (2026-10-25). Iron golems are now her kin, not Frankenstein's monster's.

Open questions

  • A copper golem when the game has one?
